notes.title: Arena Renovator full release!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Arena Renovators!
The day has come![/h3] 🏆🏆🏆

[previewyoutube=XCQ65yTU274;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Today is our BIG DAY we've been waiting for! - full release of Arena Renovation![/b]
[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/355e2c7f3a5da74be9cbb1e6a4065197528039c8.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/948880/Arena_Renovation/

Despite many difficulties and challenges - here we are and [b]you are the ones we are very grateful for.[/b] Thanks to your [b]support, reviews, information you provided,[/b] we've been able to make it to this very moment! ːsteamhappyː 🏆

[h3][b][u]To celebrate the premiere, we have a surprise for you and it is BIG, a football stadium![/u][/b]
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]football stadium is yours[/b] to run! Good luck! ⚽💪🏻
[*]we have a [b]completely new scale of activities![/b] You'll find your way around the mechanics easily, but [b]everything is just BIGGER[/b]
[*]many [b]new types of rooms:[/b] VIP, Conference, Lectures, Restaurant
[*]many [b]bug fixes![/b][/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/f5c7ab4e60c514b0d79621e30962d0b02be4073a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/fe5c5fe11e46a34b89d02328a69e5063d480cddc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/825e0f78212994fd407bafb1c7fdc41814e05aa0.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/948880/Arena_Renovation/

[i]Take on the role of a one-man renovation team tasked with restoring various sports facilities to their former glory. Many of them have been destroyed as a result of time or lack of care. Don't let them go into complete oblivion - roll up your sleeves and breathe new life into them![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31452/Arena_Renovation_and_House_Builder/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31450/Arena_Renovation_and_Farmers_Life/
